scope: Ten editorially selected public-access sports venues. A venue may contain several courts. This is not an exhaustive inventory or an assurance of access at a particular time.
special_definition: An editorial selection based on a concrete, sourced setting, history, amenity or access feature; not a ranking or certification.
location_policy: Only operator-published facility map points are populated. Other coordinates are unresolved and must remain unpinned or be explicitly labelled city representative points after a separately sourced geocoding step.

records.name: Greg Marius Court at Holcombe Rucker Park
records.access_evidence: The US Department of the Interior identifies the playground as owned and operated by NYC Parks. Manhattan Community Board 10 lists the Greg Marius basketball court and handball courts within the park.
records.hours_or_booking_note: Current opening hours and court availability were not verified. Check construction and event notices before visiting.
records.availability_warning: A March 2025 community-board resolution anticipated reconstruction beginning in late 2026 or early 2027; the NYC Public Design Commission granted final design approval in July 2026. These sources establish a project, not an actual closure date.
records.special_reason: Harlem streetball landmark associated with Holcombe Rucker's youth tournaments and generations of professional players.

evidence.supports: City ownership, Harlem location and streetball history
Named sports amenities and prospective construction timing
Certificate 30472: July 2026 final design approval

records.name: Venice Beach Recreation Center courts
records.access_evidence: The LA Recreation and Parks Venice page says its sports courts and other amenities are open to the general public daily. The facility listing names outdoor basketball, handball, sand volleyball and pickleball.
records.hours_or_booking_note: Published basketball courts are unlighted. Permitted events can use outdoor amenities; check the centre for the relevant sport and session.
records.special_reason: Public courts beside Venice's Ocean Front Walk, with beach volleyball and several court sports in one oceanfront recreation setting.

evidence.supports: Sports list, unlighted outdoor basketball and permitted-event contact
evidence.retrieval: official-page search index; direct fetch returned 403

evidence.supports: General-public daily access and Ocean Front Walk setting
evidence.retrieval: official-page search index; direct fetch returned 403

records.name: Memorial Park tennis and pickleball courts
records.access_evidence: The city's current sports page identifies Memorial Park as its primary pickleball site. Courts 2–4 are first-come, first-served outside city programmes and approved permits; reservable drop-in sessions use an ActiveNet account.
records.fee_status: Paid drop-in sessions; casual court fee not stated in the current page.
records.hours_or_booking_note: Published drop-in sessions: Monday–Thursday 17:00–21:30 and Saturday/Sunday 08:00–14:00. Check the current city calendar for programme priority and weather cancellations.
records.special_reason: A municipal pickleball hub with sixteen pickleball layouts over four tennis courts and rotating games organised through paddle stacking.

evidence.supports: Location, sports, layouts, conditional casual access, current drop-in schedule and booking
City-authorised paid reservation programme; 2023 prices are not asserted as current

records.name: Queen Elizabeth Park courts
records.access_evidence: Vancouver describes public tennis, free basketball and roller-hockey facilities. The official Park Finder lists pickleball. Casual pickleball uses first-come access with a 30-minute limit when others wait.
records.fee_status: mixed: free casual courts; selected tennis courts have seasonal book-to-play operation
records.hours_or_booking_note: Check individual court signs and seasonal Tennis BC bookings. The city identifies tennis courts 5–8 as seasonal book-to-play courts from late April to early September. Pickleball courts are not lit for evening play.
records.special_reason: Several public court sports in the same landscaped park, with free basketball and roller hockey beside the tennis area.

evidence.supports: Public tennis, free basketball and roller hockey, park setting
Casual court policy and seasonal book-to-play exceptions
Pickleball listed among park amenities
evidence.retrieval: official search-index listing; redirected app had no readable text

evidence.supports: Casual pickleball access and lighting limitation

records.qualification: Municipal pages disagree on tennis/basketball court counts and describe different seasonal arrangements. No total court count is asserted; check the actual court's sign and booking status.

records.name: The Courts at The Regent’s Park
records.access_evidence: The Royal Parks offers online public court bookings. Its FAQ requires an account, allows one court booking per person per day, and describes concession rates and card-only payment.
records.fee_status: paid; current amount depends on the booking, with eligible off-peak concessions
records.hours_or_booking_note: Daily 07:00–21:00. Tennis and padel bookings open seven days ahead, with availability released at 07:00.
records.special_reason: Bookable tennis, padel, netball and outdoor table tennis in a central London park, with step-free access and accessible restrooms.

evidence.supports: Sports, address, hours and accessibility amenities
Public booking account, payment, quotas and concession conditions

coordinate_source.basis: The operator's Google Maps link for The Courts embeds the selected place coordinates !3d51.5250842!4d-0.1535643. This is a facility reference point, not a surveyed individual court or entrance.

records.name: Courts de tennis du Jardin du Luxembourg
records.access_evidence: The French Senate states the courts are for recreational access by all athletes through online booking. The operator Anybuddy publishes current public reservation and check-in rules.
records.fee_status: paid: EUR 18 per court-hour; EUR 14 at eligible off-peak times for qualifying users
records.hours_or_booking_note: Book only via Anybuddy. Slots open five days ahead at the slot's start time. All participants must join the reservation and check in with identification at Pavillon Raynal. One hour per day; current venue availability controls hours.
records.special_reason: Recreational tennis within the Jardin du Luxembourg, with a public reservation system rather than a membership-only arrangement.

evidence.supports: 2025 reopening and Anybuddy as the exclusive booking channel
Public recreational access and the operator concession
Current published price, booking window and access conditions

records.name: Carlton Gardens community basketball courts
records.access_evidence: The City of Melbourne's public activity guide explicitly describes the northern gardens' community basketball courts and invites visitors to join games.
records.hours_or_booking_note: Specific court hours, lighting and event closures were not established by the cited guide.
records.special_reason: Community basketball beside Melbourne Museum and the Royal Exhibition Building within Carlton Gardens.

evidence.supports: Community access, northern-gardens location and neighbouring landmarks
City location and garden context

records.fee_status: paid; ActiveSG rates and eligibility apply
records.hours_or_booking_note: Daily 07:00–22:00. The facility page displayed no closure announcement when checked. Use current ActiveSG booking availability and closure notices.
records.special_reason: Government-operated public tennis with a long daily playing window from early morning until 22:00.

records.name: Victoria Park courts
records.access_evidence: LCSD lists the park's basketball and tennis facilities, their operating hours and public booking service. Tennis hire charges are published separately through SmartPLAY.
records.fee_status: paid tennis; basketball fee status not confirmed in the facility listing
records.hours_or_booking_note: Basketball 07:00–23:00 daily. Tennis 06:00–23:00 April–September and 07:00–23:00 October–March. Book fee-charging tennis through LCSD/SmartPLAY; check the exact court's availability.
records.special_reason: Urban basketball and tennis with long published hours, accessible toilets and tactile guidance among the listed amenities.

evidence.supports: Victoria Park basketball address, daily hours and accessibility amenities

Public facility-booking system and tennis hire charges

records.name: Zoo Lake public courts
records.access_evidence: South African Tourism explicitly states that Zoo Lake's tennis and basketball courts are available for public use. Johannesburg City Parks identifies the public park and location.
records.hours_or_booking_note: Court-specific hours, fees, reservation priority and current maintenance condition are not supplied by these sources; check with the park operator before travelling.
records.special_reason: Public court sports in a lakeside park associated with the Coronation Fountain and community arts and music events.

evidence.supports: Public use of tennis/basketball, lakeside setting and community events
